export type DaemonRouteMethod = "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "DELETE" | "ANY" | "WS";
export interface DaemonRoute {
    method: DaemonRouteMethod;
    path: string;
    feature?: DaemonFeature;
    summary: string;
}

export declare function describeRoute(name: DaemonRouteName, method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "DELETE"): string;
export declare function routePath(name: DaemonRouteName, params?: Record<string, string>): string;

export declare const DAEMON_EVENT_TYPES: readonly ["daemon.started", "daemon.stopping", "editor.connected", "editor.disconnected", "editor.operation", "client.connected", "client.disconnected", "call.started", "call.finished", "session.access", "leases.released", "plugins.changed", "update.available", "update.staged", "update.building", "update.applied", "update.failed", "dialog.opened", "dialog.updated", "dialog.answered", "dialog.delegated", "dialog.closed", "flow.run_started", "flow.step_started", "flow.step_completed", "flow.step_failed", "flow.run_completed", "checkpoint.created", "checkpoint.restored", "checkpoints.toggled", "checkpoints.cleared", "pie.started", "pie.ended", "pie.paused", "pie.resumed", "disruption.requested", "disruption.updated", "disruption.hold", "hub.changed", "hub.lease"];
export declare const PIE_STATES: readonly ["started", "ended", "paused", "resumed"];
export type PieState = (typeof PIE_STATES)[number];
export interface PieEventData {
    editor: string;
    state: PieState;
    simulate: boolean;
    at: string;
    resync?: boolean;
    paused?: boolean;
}
export type DaemonEventType = (typeof DAEMON_EVENT_TYPES)[number];
export declare const DAEMON_GAP_EVENT = "gap";
export interface DaemonEvent {
    id: number;
    type: string;
    at: string;
    data: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface DaemonDiscovery {
    pid: number;
    port: number;
    token: string;
    version: string;
    apiVersion: number;
    projectRoot: string;
    startedAt: string;
}
export type ContextStrategy = "full" | "lean" | "micro";
export type ActionEffect = "read" | "mutate" | "unknown";
export type ActionEffectSource = "declared" | "inferred";
export interface ElicitParams {
    message: string;
    _meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
    requestedSchema: {
        type: "object";
        properties: Record<string, ElicitPrimitiveSchema>;
        required?: string[];
    };
}
export type ElicitPrimitiveSchema = {
    type: "string";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    enum?: string[];
    enumNames?: string[];
    default?: string;
} | {
    type: "number" | "integer";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    default?: number;
} | {
    type: "boolean";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    default?: boolean;
} | (ElicitMultiSelectBase & {
    items: {
        type: "string";
        enum: string[];
    };
}) | (ElicitMultiSelectBase & {
    items: {
        anyOf: Array<{
            const: string;
            title: string;
        }>;
    };
});
interface ElicitMultiSelectBase {
    type: "array";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    minItems?: number;
    maxItems?: number;
    default?: string[];
}
export interface ElicitResult {
    action: "accept" | "decline" | "cancel";
    content?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[]>;
}
export interface ModelToolCall {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    arguments: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface ModelMessage {
    role: "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";
    content: string;
    toolCalls?: ModelToolCall[];
    toolCallId?: string;
    name?: string;
}
export interface ModelToolDefinition {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    parameters: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface ModelRequest {
    system?: string;
    prompt?: string;
    messages?: ModelMessage[];
    model?: string;
    maxTokens?: number;
    temperature?: number;
    stop?: string[];
    schema?: Record<string, unknown>;
    tools?: ModelToolDefinition[];
    toolChoice?: "auto" | "none" | "required" | {
        name: string;
    };
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}
export interface ModelResponse {
    text: string;
    parsed?: unknown;
    toolCalls?: ModelToolCall[];
    finishReason?: "stop" | "tool_use" | "length" | (string & {});
    usage?: {
        inputTokens?: number;
        outputTokens?: number;
    };
    model?: string;
}
export interface ModelProvider {
    complete(req: ModelRequest): Promise<ModelResponse>;
}
export type DialogBlock = {
    type: "paragraph";
    text: string;
} | {
    type: "table";
    columns: string[];
    rows: string[][];
    checked?: Array<boolean | null>;
    items?: Array<number | null>;
};
export interface DialogPromptRequest extends ElicitParams {
    dialog: {
        editor: string;
        title: string;
        message: string;
        buttons: string[];
        items?: Array<{
            index: number;
            label: string;
            cells: string[];
            checked: boolean;
        }>;
        blocks?: DialogBlock[];
        native?: {
            hwnd: string;
            pid: number;
            kind: "gpu-crash" | "assert" | "ensure" | "missing-modules" | "crash" | "message";
            summary: string;
            details?: string[];
        };
        subject: string;
        minHumanMs: number;
    };
}
export type DialogPromptResult = ElicitResult | {
    action: "delegate";
};
export type DialogPromptFn = (request: DialogPromptRequest) => Promise<DialogPromptResult>;
export interface DialogEventData {
    editor: string;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    buttons: string[];
    items?: Array<{
        index: number;
        label: string;
        cells: string[];
        checked: boolean;
    }>;

export interface AssetDiffRecord {

        name: string;

        linkedTo: string[];

export interface ExtensionRequest {

export interface CallActionOptions {
    dialogPrompt?: DialogPromptFn;
    dialogWaitMs?: number;
    elicit?: (params: ElicitParams) => Promise<ElicitResult>;
    access?: "read-write" | "read-only";
    signal?: AbortSignal;

        id: string;
        label?: string;
        parent?: string;

    isError: boolean;
    content: Array<{
        type: string;
        text?: string;
    }>;
}
export interface ExtensionServicesApi {
    provide(id: string, impl: unknown): () => void;
    get<T>(id: string): T | undefined;
    watch<T>(id: string, cb: (impl: T | undefined) => void): () => void;
}
export interface DaemonExtensionApi {
    apiVersion: number;
    version: string;
    projectDir: string;
    dataDir: string;
    events: {
        publish(type: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): DaemonEvent;
        subscribe(listener: (e: DaemonEvent) => void): () => void;
        since(lastId: number): {
            events: DaemonEvent[];
            gap: boolean;
        };
    };
    route(method: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE", path: string, handler: ExtensionHandler): void;
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: CallActionOptions): Promise<ActionResult>;
    features?: readonly string[];
    nativeDialogs?: {
        list(): NativeDialogView[];
        press(hwnd: string, button: string, opts?: {
            pid?: number;
        }): Promise<NativeDialogPressResult>;
    };
    flows?: {
        approveSteps(approver: FlowStepApprover): () => void;
    };
    services?: ExtensionServicesApi;
    models?: {
        register(provider: ModelProvider): () => void;
    };
    checkpoints?: {
        state(opts?: {
            editor?: string;
            limit?: number;
        }): Promise<CheckpointState>;
        setEnabled(enabled: boolean | null, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<CheckpointState>;
        create(label?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<CheckpointResult>;
        changes(from: string, to?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
            assetDiffs?: boolean;
        }): Promise<ChangesResult>;
        assetDiff?(from: string, to: string | undefined, path: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<AssetDiff>;
        thumbnail?(id: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): {
            file: string;
            type: string;
        } | null;
        openNativeDiff?(path: string, from: string, to?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<NativeDiffResult>;
        restore(checkpoint: string, opts?: {
            paths?: string[];
            force?: boolean;
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<RestoreResult>;
        clear(opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<{
            editor: string;
            cleared: true;
        }>;
    };
    skills?: {
        list(): DaemonSkill[];
    };
    context?: {
        project(opts: ContextProjectionOptions): ContextProjection;
        call(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: ContextCallOptions): Promise<ActionResult>;
    };
    actions?: {
        effects(categories?: string[]): ActionEffectInfo[];
    };
    versions?(): {
        loaded: string;
        recorded: string | null;
        installed: string[];
    };
    editors(): EditorStatus[];
    editorOperation(op: "start" | "stop" | "restart" | "rebuild", opts?: EditorOperationOptions): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
    setBusy(busy: () => boolean): void;
    hub?: {
        configure(options: import("./hub-ports.js").HubClientOptions): () => void;
    };
    ui: {
        trustKey(pem: string): void;
        install(dir: string): UiManifest;
        active(): UiManifest | null;
        own?(): UiManifest | null;
    };
    registryAccount(): Promise<{
        login: string;
        token: string;
        registry: string;
    } | null>;
    modes?: {
        get(): {
            feedback: {
                mode: "interactive" | "auto-approve" | "defer";
                project: boolean;
            };
            dialog: {
                mode: "interactive" | "auto" | "defer" | null;
                project: boolean;
            };
            playtest: {
                mode: "manual" | "automatic" | null;
                project: boolean;
            };
        };
        setFeedback(mode: "interactive" | "auto-approve" | "defer" | undefined): void;
        setDialog(mode: "interactive" | "auto" | "defer" | undefined): void;
        setPlaytest(mode: "manual" | "automatic" | undefined): void;
    };
    log: {
        info(message: string): void;
        warn(message: string, detail?: unknown): void;
    };
}
export interface DaemonExtension {
    activate(api: DaemonExtensionApi): void | {
        dispose?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    } | Promise<void | {
        dispose?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    }>;
}

export type SuiteItem = {
    test: string;
} | {
    suite: string;
};
export interface Suite {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    items: SuiteItem[];
    quarantined: string[];
    flaky: string[];
}
export type SuiteDraft = Partial<Omit<Suite, "id">> & {
    id?: string;
};
export declare function suiteOf(v: unknown, id: string): {
    suite: Suite;
    findings: HubFinding[];
};
export declare function suiteLoop(suites: ReadonlyMap<string, Pick<Suite, "items">>, id: string): string[] | null;
export declare function suiteTests(suites: ReadonlyMap<string, Pick<Suite, "items">>, id: string): {
    tests: string[];
    missingSuites: string[];
};
export declare function fileText(kind: "clip", v: Clip): string;
export declare function fileText(kind: "arrangement", v: Arrangement): string;
export declare function fileText(kind: "suite", v: Suite): string;
export type RunnerKind = "editor" | "headless";
export type RunSource = "person" | "agent" | "schedule";
export type CheckStatus = "pending" | "running" | "passed" | "failed" | "awaiting_verdict" | "skipped";
export type RunState = "starting" | "running" | "awaiting_verdict" | "passed" | "failed" | "error" | "stopped";
export declare const ENDED_STATES: readonly RunState[];
export declare const runEnded: (s: RunState) => boolean;
export interface CheckResult {
    id: string;
    status: CheckStatus;
    frame?: number;
    message?: string;
    verdict?: {
        by: "person" | "agent";
        note?: string;
        at: string;
    };
}
export type RunVcs = "git" | "perforce" | "plastic" | "svn" | "none";
export interface CurrentProvenance {
    vcs: RunVcs | null;
    revision: string | null;
    dirty: number | null;
}
export interface RunRecord {
    runId: string;
    test: string;
    title: string;
    runner: RunnerKind;
    source: RunSource;
    batch: string;
    suite?: string;
    startedAt: string;
    endedAt: string | null;
    state: RunState;
    checks: CheckResult[];
    frame?: number;
    error?: string;
    revision: string | null;
    dirty: number | null;
}
export declare function stateFromChecks(checks: readonly Pick<CheckResult, "status">[]): RunState;
export type TestHealth = "running" | "failing" | "flaky" | "passing" | "never_run" | "missing";
export type SuiteHealth = "running" | "failing" | "flaky" | "never_run" | "passing" | "empty";
export declare const TEST_HEALTH_ORDER: readonly TestHealth[];
export declare const FLAKY_WINDOW = 5;
export declare const PASS_RATE_WINDOW = 20;
export declare function flakiness(runs: readonly RunRecord[], window?: number): {
    flaky: boolean;
    checks: string[];
};
export declare function passRate(runs: readonly RunRecord[], window?: number): number | null;
export declare function testHealth(runs: readonly RunRecord[], o?: {
    missing?: boolean;
    window?: number;
}): TestHealth;
export interface RunSummary {
    runId: string;
    state: RunState;
    startedAt: string;
    endedAt: string | null;
}
export interface TestState {
    id: string;
    arrangement: string;
    region?: string;
    title: string;
    health: TestHealth;
    checks: number;
    passRate: number | null;
    flaky: {
        detected: boolean;
        marked: boolean;
        checks: string[];
    };
    quarantined: boolean;
    last?: RunSummary;
}
export interface PassRatePoint {
    batch: string;
    at: string;
    passed: number;
    total: number;
    rate: number;
}
export interface SuiteState {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    items: SuiteItem[];
    health: SuiteHealth;
    passRate: number | null;
    history: PassRatePoint[];
    tests: TestState[];
    quarantined: string[];
    flaky: string[];
    missing: string[];
}
export declare function suiteHealth(tests: readonly Pick<TestState, "health" | "quarantined" | "flaky">[]): SuiteHealth;
export declare function passRateHistory(tests: ReadonlySet<string>, runs: readonly RunRecord[], max?: number): PassRatePoint[];
export interface QueueItem {
    id: string;
    test: string;
    title: string;
    runner: RunnerKind;
    source: RunSource;
    batch: string;
    suite?: string;
    queuedAt: string;
    state: "queued" | "running";
    runId?: string;
    runnerReason?: string;
}
export interface QueueRequest {
    test?: string;
    suite?: string;
    runner?: RunnerKind;
    next?: boolean;
}
export interface QueueState {
    paused: boolean;
    waiting: OccupancyReason[];
    waitingHeadless?: string;
    running: QueueItem[];
    queued: QueueItem[];
}
export interface Schedule {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    suite?: string;
    test?: string;
    runner: RunnerKind;
    days: number[];
    time: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    lastRunAt: string | null;
}
export type ScheduleDraft = Partial<Omit<Schedule, "id" | "lastRunAt">>;
export declare const SCHEDULE_TIME: RegExp;
export type OccupancyKind = "disconnected" | "operation" | "dialog" | "pie" | "agent" | "client" | "input" | "session" | "consent";
export interface OccupancyReason {
    kind: OccupancyKind;
    text: string;
}
export interface EditorLease {
    editor: string;
    purpose: string;
    item: string;
    runId?: string | null;
    pie?: boolean;
    since: string;
}
export interface HubLeaseEvent {
    lease: EditorLease | null;
}
export declare const HUB_LEASE = "hub.lease";
export interface BusyCall {
    id: number;
    category: string;
    action: string;
    startedAt: number;
    source: "agent" | "client";
    sessionId?: string;
    client?: string;
    stopped: boolean;
}
export interface EditorOperation {
    op: "start" | "stop" | "restart" | "rebuild";
    step: string;
    startedAt: number;
    stepStartedAt: number;
}
export interface EditorOperationFailure {
    op: EditorOperation["op"];
    step: string;
    reason: string;
    at: number;
}
export interface BusyState {
    now: number;
    calls: BusyCall[];
    operation?: EditorOperation;
    failure?: EditorOperationFailure;
}
export interface ClipSummary {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    performer: PerformerKind;
    rate: number;
    length: number;
    lanes: number;
    usedBy: string[];
}
export interface ArrangementSummary {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    level: string | null;
    tracks: number;
    checks: number;
    regions: Array<Pick<Region, "id" | "name">>;
    length: number;
    findings: HubFinding[];
}
export interface FileProblem {
    kind: HubKind;
    id: string;
    file: string;
    findings: HubFinding[];
}
export interface HubOverview {
    clips: ClipSummary[];
    arrangements: ArrangementSummary[];
    suites: SuiteState[];
    tests: TestState[];
    queue: QueueState;
    lease: EditorLease | null;
    recent: RunRecord[];
    schedules: Schedule[];
    problems: FileProblem[];
}
export interface ArrangementView {
    arrangement: Arrangement;
    length: number;
    findings: HubFinding[];
    clips: Record<string, Clip>;
    tests: TestState[];
}
export interface TestDetail {
    test: TestState;
    checks: Check[];
    runs: RunRecord[];
}
export interface PlayRequest {
    runId: string;
    arrangement: Arrangement;
    clips: Record<string, Clip>;
    region?: string;
    from?: number;
    loop?: boolean;
}
export interface PlayStatus {
    runId: string;
    state: "starting" | "running" | "awaiting_verdict" | "finished" | "stopped" | "error";
    frame?: number;
    checks: CheckResult[];
    error?: string;
    pieStarted?: boolean;
    pass?: number;
}
export interface AuditionRequest {
    test: string;
    from?: number;
    loop?: boolean;
}
export interface AuditionState {
    playId: string;
    test: string;
    from: number;
    loop: boolean;
    startedAt: string;
    state: PlayStatus["state"];
    frame?: number;
    pass?: number;
    checks: CheckResult[];
    error?: string;
}
export type HubChangedWhat = "clips" | "arrangements" | "suites" | "runs" | "queue" | "schedules" | "play";
export interface HubChanged {
    what: HubChangedWhat[];
    id?: string;
    runId?: string;
}
export declare const HUB_CHANGED = "hub.changed";

// ── contract/hub-performers.ts ──
export declare const PERFORMER_KINDS: readonly ["player"];
export type PerformerKind = (typeof PERFORMER_KINDS)[number];
export interface PlayerPerformer {
    kind: "player";
    client: number;
}
export type Performer = PlayerPerformer;
export declare const PERFORMER_CLIENT_MAX = 15;
export declare const DEFAULT_PERFORMER: PlayerPerformer;
export declare function performerOf(v: unknown): Performer | null;
export declare function performerProblem(v: unknown): string;
export declare function performerFromText(s: string): Performer | null;
export declare function performerToText(p: Performer): string;
export declare function performerKey(p: Performer): string;
export declare function samePerformer(a: Performer, b: Performer): boolean;
export declare function performerLabel(p: Performer): string;
export declare function trackPerformer(t: {
    performer?: unknown;
    player?: unknown;
}): Performer;
export declare function performerPlayer(p: Performer): number;
export interface PerformerCandidate {
    performer: Performer;
    label: string;
}
export interface PerformersView {
    performers: PerformerCandidate[];
}

// ── contract/hub-ports.ts ──
import type { ActionResult } from "./daemon.js";
import type { BusyCall, PlayRequest, PlayStatus, RunnerKind } from "./hub.js";
export interface HubHost {
    projectDir: string;
    dataDir: string;
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ActionResult>;
    editors(): Array<{
        connected: boolean;
    }>;
    events: {
        publish(type: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): unknown;
        subscribe(listener: (e: {
            type: string;
            data: Record<string, unknown>;
        }) => void): () => void;
    };
    log: {
        warn(message: string, detail?: unknown): void;
    };
}
export interface HubRunner {
    readonly kind: RunnerKind;
    unavailable(): string | null;
    play(request: PlayRequest): Promise<{
        pieStarted?: boolean;
    }>;
    status(runId: string): Promise<PlayStatus>;
    stop(runId: string, reason: string): Promise<void>;
    verdict(runId: string, check: string, verdict: "pass" | "fail", note?: string): Promise<void>;
    close?(reason: string): Promise<void>;
}
export interface HubClientOptions {
    enabled?: () => boolean;
    inputAgeMs?: () => number | null;
    agentCalls?: () => BusyCall[];
    headless?: HubRunner;
}
export interface CallingHost<O = unknown> {
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>, options?: O): Promise<ActionResult>;
}

// ── helpers exported beside it ──
export declare const discoveryPath: (projectDir: string) => string;
export declare const parseContextMeasurement: (value: unknown) => ContextMeasurementParse;
export declare const readDiscovery: (projectDir: string) => DaemonDiscovery | null;
export declare const readLiveDiscovery: (projectDir: string, isAlive?: (pid: number) => boolean) => DaemonDiscovery | null;
export declare const scopeBucket: (categoryCount: number) => ContextScopeBucket;
export declare const signBundle: (dir: string, meta: { name: string; version: string; api: { min: number; max: number; }; module?: { entry: string; host: string; } | undefined; }, privateKeyPem: string) => UiManifest;
export declare const verifyBundle: (dir: string, trustedKeys: readonly KeyObject[] | ((name: string) => readonly KeyObject[])) => UiManifest;
